description: This file defines and configures approval capabilities for the Matrix channel, including target resolution, approval request handling, and native/delivery adapters for approval workflows.

methods.name: normalizeComparableTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a target string for comparison, handling user and other target kinds.

methods.name: resolveMatrixNativeTarget
methods.description: Resolves a raw string to a Matrix target identifier, returning 'user:' or 'room:' prefixed string.

methods.name: normalizeThreadId
methods.description: Normalizes thread ID values to a trimmed string or undefined.

methods.name: resolveTurnSourceMatrixOriginTarget
methods.description: Resolves the origin target for a turn source request if it is a Matrix channel.

methods.name: resolveSessionMatrixOriginTarget
methods.description: Resolves the origin target for a session, returning a MatrixOriginTarget object.

methods.name: matrixTargetsMatch
methods.description: Checks if two MatrixOriginTarget objects refer to the same target and thread.

methods.name: hasMatrixPluginApprovers
methods.description: Determines if there are any plugin approvers configured for Matrix.
